The rules of contact

Speak a little Taami

Taami is the old Lyran (Man) language and the official diplomatic language of the Galactic Federation of Worlds. Endings: -a feminine, -u masculine, -i plural. After a long Pleiadean presence on Earth, traces of it survive in Earth languages. Many races speak their own languages: Grays sound like crackling insects, some speak in frequencies like dolphins and whales, and the O communicate in a way beyond telepathy.

            Founders

            The full account of the Founders, the 24 Seeder civilisations, the Nine, the Anunnaki and the true history of Earth, part by part, with its drawings, plus the complete guide to blood and genes.

            Everything known about the Founders, gathered by topic: who they are, the Nine above them, how humans were made, the history of Earth, the Arks and Stargates, Atlantis, magic, contact and the teachings for starseeds.

            All of this comes from contact and channelled material and is presented as claims, not established fact.

            Who is who

            The order of beings and powers, from Source down to the custodians of Earth.

            SourceThe origin of all consciousness and matter. Every soul is a fractal of Source, with a direct link to it that needs no priest, religion or go-between.
            The NineNine bodiless plasma super-consciousnesses, the highest individual awareness below Source. They live in the Void between universes, outside time, and guide whole galaxies.
            Intergalactic ConfederationA union of cultures spread over many galaxies that acts as the executive arm of the Nine. Taami name: Ard Oraa Tu. Also called the Do, the Guardians or the Founders.
            The 24 SeedersThe Confederation’s life-engineering civilisations. They spread and combine existing genomes to seed and repopulate worlds. The oldest and leading race is the Pa-Taal.
            Galactic Federation of WorldsThe alliance of worlds inside our own galaxy, Nataru. Real name: Oraa Nataru Shari (Oraa = elements joined into a group; Nataru = our galaxy; Shari = worlds or cultures). Its law is the Prime Directive.
            High CouncilThe Federation’s top council: 24 members plus one Law-Keeper who makes final decisions; the Law-Keeper role rotates every 10 galactic cycles. The Confederation also has a council of 24.
            Council of FiveThe surviving members of the old Orion Council of Nine: Orela, Egaroth, Ginvo, Redan and Emerther. Independent of the Federation, it respects free will but has more freedom to act, and runs the Envoy Program.
            Zenae (Andromedans)The Andromedan Council, led by nine elders; part of the Galactic Alliance that freed the solar system.
            CustodiansStar peoples who later claimed Earth as a colony, such as the Anunnaki.
            NebuThe Orion Tall Grays (Eban of Betelgeuse, Grail of Mintaka, Indugutk of Bellatrix) joined in one hive mind; ‘the Masters’ or ‘the Dominion’.
            CiakahrrThe reptilian empire of Draco, with a sorcerer-priest caste called the Giansar.
            Respect, not rankNo being is superior to another; differences are of origin, nature, energy and role. Advanced beings are greeted with respect, never worship.

            The Nine

            Nine principles of the universe, living as one consciousness in the Void.

            What they areIndividual plasma super-consciousnesses that together form one being. Each embodies one principle of the universe; together they are the universe’s nine-fold structure, a fractal of Source on base nine.
            Where they liveIn the Void: uncreated, between dimensions, outside time and outside every universe. They can be anywhere at once and connect to any place or time.
            Not a councilA council belongs to a physical culture. The Nine are not a council, have no hierarchy and are not incarnated. They need no ships and can take any form, even fire or water.
            Like light through a prismThe nine principles are like colours split from white light that merge back into white. Every being carries the same nine principles inside.
            TumThe messenger of the Nine, also called Temu: the key, the bridge and the singularity of the vortex that connects them to creation. Remembered in Egypt as Atum, the creator.
            Their executive handsThe Intergalactic Confederation works for the Nine under the Greater Law of One. It regards them as elders and guides at the balance point between order and chaos, not as superiors.
            True formFluid, coloured shapes of light like giant cells, each with a spinning node that downloads from Source the formula of any life form: the mechanism of creation itself.
            The Egyptian NineThe Great Ennead of Heliopolis: Atum, Shu, Tefnut, Geb, Nut, Osiris, Isis, Seth and Nephthys. Ancient rulers of Earth modelled their pantheon on the Nine, but those gods were not the Nine.
            Natjaru and NataruThe Egyptian word for gods, Natjaru, echoes Nataru, the star peoples’ name for our galaxy.
            Why nine is sacred1 is the individual and oneness; 2 the pair and polarity; 3 the many; 9 = 3 × 3, the infinite. 1 + 2 + … + 9 = 45, and 4 + 5 = 9. Adding 9 to any number keeps its digit sum.
            Nine in traditionYggdrasil has nine realms and the Vegvisir is the compass of the nine realms. Druid lore says circling a well nine times clockwise opens a door to the Fae. Human pregnancy lasts nine months.
            3:33The Nine’s signature time is 3:33, since 3 + 3 + 3 = 9.
            A living universeThe universe is a conscious being that breathes in cycles, learns and grows. Every living being is one of its cells.
            Why darkness existsLike a body letting some cells fall ill so others discover their strength, the universe allows destructive cultures for a time. They challenge others to grow, and they too are children of Source.
            Three forcesCreation, Balance and Resonance stand against Destruction, Chaos and Dissonance. The tension between them drives evolution; the Nine sit at the exact point of balance; love binds all creation together.
            Time is a sphereWherever there is gravity, time forms a sphere around the body (planet, star, galaxy core). Inside it consciousness experiences mortality; outside it, consciousness is free of time.
            A hologram is realA hologram is not an illusion but the physics that binds reality together.
            Everything is fractalAll creation is built from mathematical equations linked by one constant. All shapes are fractal geometry, consciousness included, and all fractals lead back to Source.
            Knowledge freesSocieties are enslaved by blocking knowledge and lifted by education. Thoughts are actions.
            No godsThere are no gods, goddesses, lords or masters, only consciousness. Source is acknowledged as part of all that is, not worshipped.
            RememberingThe point was never to erase memory but to challenge beings to remember; remembering unlocks the power in DNA.

            The Seeders and the 24 races

            The intergalactic founders of human life in our galaxy.

            Their workThe 24 do not create life; Source does. They combine existing life into new hybrid races and seed worlds, following the laws of evolution.
            Humanity’s forebearsHuman life in our galaxy was first seeded in Lyra (Mana, K62-Lyra). Earth is one of the special worlds that carry the Seeders’ seeds.
            Living shipsConfederation ships are built of crystal, which gives them consciousness and an organic look: flower-like airlocks, tunnels of translucent rings, crystal halls and soft floors.
            Guardians of LifeThey repopulate damaged worlds, terraform barren ones, start civilisations and watch them grow. Many of them chose to incarnate among the races they seeded as guides.
            Outposts near EarthGanymede (the main one), under the Atlantic Ocean, and the La Pass (Kongka La) valley in Ladakh, in the Himalayas.
            20,000 years aheadTheir genetic science is about 20,000 years ahead of Earth’s.

            Orion, the Hive and the Nebu

            The war over Orion’s super-Stargate and the hive empire it produced.

            The super-StargateA Stargate in the Trapezium cluster of the Orion Nebula (M42), about 1,500 light-years away, formed by a collapsed star. Its double inverted vortex reaches into the Void and works as a time machine; whoever holds it controls the multiverse.
            Uru An Na‘The light of the cosmos’ in Ana’Kh, the Anunnaki language. The Anunnaki owned the gate first; the name later covered all of Orion.
            The Merkaba shapeTwo vortices spinning in opposite directions form a Merkaba, the ‘Star of Creation’, with a singularity at its centre. The fully activated human energy field has the same structure: activated humans are living Stargates.
            The NebuThe Tall Gray races of Orion, each once with its own hive, merged into one: the Eban (Betelgeuse; geneticists and slave-makers, rulers of the Hive), the Indugutk (Bellatrix; very violent) and the Grail (Mintaka). Rigel held their armies and clone factories; Betelgeuse their heavy artillery.
            Kaaba, the cubeThe Nebu took the Trapezium cluster, renamed it Kaaba (‘the cube’ in the Grail language) and placed the central mind of the Hive there.
            Why they chose M42Four huge young stars flood it with ultraviolet light, which the Tall Grays live on; normal light harms them.
            Servant racesSmall Grays, mostly the Xrog of Zeta Reticuli, and a faction of the Solipsi Rai of Cygnus linked by injected nanobots.
            Not all GraysGrays can live outside a hive; the Cygnus Solipsi Rai, for example, are not connected. ‘Do’ is the galaxy-wide name for the Gray species; ‘Nebu’ means only the Orion dominion.
            The Hive QueenNot a living body but a disembodied super-consciousness, like a quantum AI, possibly inside the portal itself. Like a hydra, killing her makes her stronger; she can only be stopped by destroying her web and sealing her in a non-dimensional void.
            How Grays are linkedBy mind, or by ‘tracker dust’: tiny synthetic hydras in the nervous system joined by a quantum frequency key. Linking humans would require changing human DNA into hybrid Gray DNA, because blood and DNA carry their own frequency signatures.
            RemovalCaptured or ‘infected’ hive members are pulled out of their bodies and merged back into the Hive in Uru An Na. The Nebu never negotiate.
            The XrogAlso called Shamtbahali. Twin cold, airless planets in Zeta Reticuli joined by artificial bridges; half-insectoid, four fingers, telepathic with throat crackles, black uniforms, large silver discs. Their culture is mother-centred: they are the Hive’s nerves, she is its brain. Their deepest fear is being alone without the Hive.
            Three forms of small GrayOriginal biological, hybrid, and synthetic clones; synthetic ones feel nothing and are made of the same material as their ships.
            The Orion WarsBefore the Federation existed, Orion’s thousands of worlds lived in peace. The Tall Grays allied to seize the region and its super-portal; the Anunnaki, the only power that could stop them, had already left.
            The Black LeagueAfter the Eban destroyed a rebel planet in the Betelgeuse system, survivors from Alnitak, Betelgeuse and Meissa united under the war leader Akhan, ‘the General’.
            The Alliance of the SixThe Nebu’s answer: a trading pact promising shares of the super-Stargate to the Maytra (Andromeda), Kiily-Tokurt (Vela), Ciakahrr (Draco), the Corporate of Altair and the compromised Ashtar Collective of Sirius B.
            Why wars never endAdvanced peoples use time-bending to go back and change the result of battles, so wars become tangled and long. Earth’s long struggle between star factions is one example.
            The Orion Council of NineAn ancient pacifist council of sages on Alnilam, founded by the Elmanuk of Ardamant: Elmanuk, Ginvo, Emerther, Egaroth, Redan, Orela, Marvo and two now-extinct cultures. They lived at a higher density, beyond the Nebu’s reach, and kept the region’s frequency high.
            Dorm DorhuThe spiritual combat arts the Council taught the Black League, created by the Ohorai of Arcturus and very like the Jedi arts. The Orion Wars inspired Star Wars.
            From Nine to FiveWhen the Elmanuk proposed training resistance cells across the galaxy, the Marvo and two others left. The Egaroth were put in charge of what became the Council of Five.
            The Envoy ProgramThe Black League lost only in appearance: most of its members joined the Envoy Program, incarnating in waves on oppressed worlds to wake people up. Akhan was among the first to enrol on Earth.
            Birth of the FederationIn the same period the Galactic Federation of Worlds formed, with the Prime Directive protecting free will.
            Alnilam and ZaggarahThe Council of Five’s seat is on Zaggarah 3, the Egaroth mother world in the Alnilam system: a brown planet marbled with white clouds and purple spots, with two moons. Its worlds sit in a higher density the Nebu cannot reach.
            The Meeting CastleA square building with pointed domes from the time of the Orion Wars. Its original hall keeps a metal disc cut into nine segments with nine empty seats; its emblem is a triangle with added corners, meaning nine.
            Holographic councilsAdvanced councils meet by unhackable quantum holographic projection, so a seat can be destroyed without harming the council. The Federation has no fixed headquarters.
            The EgarothOf Zaggarah and Daro, about 2,000 light-years away; one of the oldest cultures of Orion. Close to human, sharing an ancestor with the Grays but with individual minds, not a hive. For them time is a bubble in which all moments are equally far from eternity.

            Blood and genes

            How humans were built in layers, what blood carries, and how DNA works.

            Built in layersHumans were not made once by one group. They were built up over millions of years by many star peoples, which is why human blood and DNA are so valuable. Between the stars DNA is currency, and Earth human blood is the most valuable of all.
            Blood is memoryBlood carries the memory and psychic abilities of a species. A body’s blood tells the story of its tribe.
            LayerGenomes
            1 · Earth base (1)A small Earth primate chosen by the Seeders; work on it began 65 million years ago.
            2 · Other galaxies (11), added by the Pa-TaalHuman: Pa-Taal, Altean, Ellii-Ym, Hoovid, Oyora-Maruu, Etherian. Reptilian: Arag’Un. Insectoid: Ashai. Gray: Z-Neel. Vegetal: Egoni. Feline: Elyan.
            3 · Our galaxy (10), in order of arrivalNaga reptilians; Anunnaki (Sirius B / Orion, Aldebaran); Taal (root Oyora); Noor and Ahel (root Ellii-Ym); T-Ashkeru (Sirius B); Selosians (root Altean); Ummit and Meton (Wolf 424, Proxima Centauri); Ohorai of Bootes; Grays (Eban, Xrog, Do-Hu, Rigel, Solipsi Rai, Kiily-Tokurt).
            Four root racesThe eleven intergalactic genomes include all four root races (Human, Reptilian, Insectoid, Gray) plus Feline and Vegetal.
            Unplanned helpSeveral later visitors unknowingly strengthened genes the Seeders had already planted.
            Not everyone has all 22Most people carry some of the genomes, perhaps six, seven or eight; carrying all 22 is rare. This mix explains the great differences between people.
            ActivatorsPeople who carry all 22 are activators: they wake others who are asleep and can unlock ancient Seeder technology, such as the Ark under Lake Vostok.
            Almost everyone is a hybridNearly everyone on Earth is an alien hybrid to some degree; only a few very remote tribes are not.
            The starting pointEarth’s early humans, called the Black Heads in Sumerian, already carried the Seeders’ work: 12 DNA strands of great potential. The Anunnaki did not know this at first.
            The AdamuThe Anunnaki engineered hybrids by mixing a male’s body with ‘clay’, a bio-gel holding engineered cells, and growing it in a female’s womb. The hybrids were called the Adamu.
            A body without a matching soulThe first hybrids had advanced bodies but primitive consciousness, which suited Enlil’s plan for a slave workforce. Technology can upgrade a body but not speed up a soul’s growth.
            Adam, the first StarseedIn 360,000 BC Enki added his own DNA to raise the bodies’ frequency, so more advanced souls could be born into them. The result was Adam, the first soul from elsewhere born into raw Earth genes.
            Llth and the first femalesEnki’s first female hybrid, Llth, ‘the glorious one’, was unbalanced. The first female paired with Adam died young because her energy body did not match her physical body. A new female was made from Adam’s own genes in the Eden laboratory, and both were later activated.
            Enlil’s answerEnlil expelled them from the lab, switched off most of the 12 strands to keep humans docile, and caused droughts and floods to wipe out the upgraded humans. He failed.
            Enki’s keyEnki saved the original genetic codes and hid a key in human DNA to reactivate every strand, located at the forehead.
            Two strands of societyUpgraded bodies at first carried souls only from Enki’s own group, creating two strands of humanity, one more and one less advanced. Earth’s etheric layer also had to be upgraded so that higher souls could enter.
            Type OBlood type O is of off-world origin, brought by the Anunnaki. At first Anunnaki blood did not match Earth blood.
            The D protein (Rh+)A bridge protein, D (Rhesus positive), was engineered as the first link between the Earth and Anunnaki genomes, in the Adamu. Through mixing, D later spread into every blood type.
            O positiveThe best match for reptiloids (Reptilians and most Grays). O-type people are the most often taken for hybrid programs, and their energy field shifts density easily.
            O negativeCarries the Anunnaki vibration and strong psychic ability; prized for its off-world origin. The Nebu sought it to crack the codes of human abilities.
            Not explainedWhere types A, B and AB come from, or what Rh-negative A, B and AB mean, is not covered.
            Blood as an ID cardBlood types are the identifying key of star genetics. DNA gives off frequency codes a scanner can read and map across the Earth by percentage of genetic match.
            Mainstream viewConventional science explains blood groups through ordinary human evolution; a blood test shows nothing about star ancestry or abilities.
            Why bloodlines matterA star soul can only be born into a body whose DNA frequency matches its own; otherwise neither body nor soul can hold together. An Ahel soul, for example, needs a body with enough Ahel DNA.
            Bloodline activationThe Council of Five scans for matching bloodlines, switches on sleeping strands and adds star DNA over generations, gently and unconsciously, so higher souls can incarnate. The Federation cannot do this because of its consent law.
            Passed downActivated DNA passes its potential on to the next generation.
            Stage 1 · seedA seed of consciousness, a fractal of Source, is planted in a planet’s matrix and grows through mineral, plant and animal life. That planet is its home.
            Stage 2 · starseedThe soul (Is-Be) is mature enough to incarnate on other worlds. A starseed on a shared mission is an Envoy.
            Stage 3 · returnThe soul stops incarnating and merges back into Source.
            Two dragonsDNA’s two coils are mirrored by the kundalini: the red dragon (feminine) and the white dragon (masculine) rising up the spine until they meet in the pineal gland, which opens a portal to other dimensions.
            The pineal glandThe portal to all knowledge and the door to genetic memory; the ‘apple’ of the Eden story stands for it.
            Coded in symbolsThe same knowledge is coded in the Uraeus of the pharaohs, the caduceus, the Celtic red and white dragons, the druid egg, the Anunnaki Tree of Life and Yggdrasil.
            The serpent is your powerThe serpent of the Tree of Life is humanity’s own power, made to look evil by those who did not want people to awaken.
            Antenna beyond timeDNA is a transmitter and receiver beyond space and time. It makes tiny magnetic wormholes and passes information to the cells and the soul, which explains intuition, healing, self-repair and travel through space and time.
            Like quartzFully activated DNA vibrates like quartz, refracts light like a crystal and fills the body’s field with light.
            Reprogrammed by soundDNA is made of frequencies, so thought, intention and above all sound can reprogram it. Spoken intentions work better than silent ones; chants and mantras work best. Sound can create light.
            The key of evolutionDNA reprograms itself to adapt; this is the core of evolution and the immortality key of a species. Blocked, a species dies out.
            The GrailThe original, unspoiled human DNA sequence. Laid over today’s altered pattern, it reactivates sleeping strands. Its frequency key has been given to the Federation’s High Council for medical technology.
            Two ways back in timeThe Path of the Blood follows the DNA of your ancestors; the Path of Spirit follows your soul’s past lives. You can only observe places and times where you once lived.
            The line of EnkiAdam and the Adamu, then the Patriarchs. Noah’s line (the flood hero also called Utnapishtim or Ziusudra) carried the precious Adamu DNA; the voice that warned Noah was Enki. Marduk, son of Enki and Ninhursag, ruled the Egyptian colony as Ra; Enki is linked to Ptah.
            The line of EnlilMade to rule over the workers. Enlil used the title Yahweh to stir wars and division and hunted Noah’s line. His line later interbred with a Ciakahrr royal line, producing hybrid ruling elites.
            The NephilimAn Anunnaki sub-group of the second arrival (5,400 BC) who bred with humans, giving giants about 8 ft tall. Kingship then passed to hybrid kings, then to human kings.
            The line through YeshuaYeshua was an Envoy born into Enki’s royal line through the Adamu, the Patriarchs and David, carrying all the genomes. That is the source of his abilities and his ‘love-power’, love being a force that holds the holographic universe together. The line, called Sang Réal, continued through Mary Magdalene and the Merovingians in anonymity.
            Two brothers in mythThe struggle between Enki and Enlil is retold as Osiris and Seth.
            Five genetic programsThe Seeders (65 million years ago to about 250,000 BC); the Anunnaki, in two lines (from 372,000 BC); the Ciakahrr (from about 5,700 years ago); the Nebu (1940s to 2021, to replace humans); and the Council of Five (ongoing, preparing bloodlines for Envoys).
            DNA Arks and EdensBefore the Flood, Enki saved Earth’s genetic heritage in Arks carrying animals and DNA samples of all life; some went to a cosmic DNA bank in a distant galaxy. An Eden is a biodome that recreates a home world’s nature and keeps its DNA library.

            MerrowThe animal the Pa-Taal chose as the base for humans, kept on an Altean archive world: cat-sized, creamy fur, a long striped tail, big round brown eyes and tufted ears, like a large ring-tailed lemur.

            Enki, Enlil and the Anunnaki

            Who the Anunnaki are, why they came, and the two brothers.

            What they areA hybrid race: part Tall Gray (probably Eban of Betelgeuse) and part T-Ashkeru, the humans of Sirius B. ‘Anunnaki’ means ‘human-like’. They have reptiloid genes but are mammals, which is rare and found only in Tall Grays not tied to a hive.
            Where they come fromTheir first home is around the star Imma-Uru, ‘the Great Mother of Light’, now in a parallel dimension; the prime homeworld is Ashtari. Their society spans many worlds, centred on the Immaru system. Before the Orion Wars they ruled the Orion zone from Aldebaran (Jada) to Sirius (Ashkera).
            Nibiru is a shipNibiru is not a planet but their giant spherical mothership. ‘Nibi-Ru’ means ‘one from two’, after their double origin. Their early mothership was Nebu-Uru, ‘the Masters of the Light-Door’.
            DensitiesThey arrived at the 3rd density and later raised their frequency to escape the Orion Wars. Their ship sits at the 6th density of our dimension; in their own dimension Enki is at the 9th density and Source at the 16th. Here there are 12 densities, with Source at the 13th.
            EternalsThey clone themselves and move from body to body, each body lasting many thousands of years, which avoids reincarnation. The perfect unchanging state is called Abra’Ah. They are masters of magic and alchemy.
            Not godsThey are immortal but not gods: respect them, never bow. They interface with a collective but are not a hive.
            GoldThey came above all for gold, the hardest metal to mine. From it they make monatomic gold, the ‘dust of immortality’, which renews cells, boosts immunity and makes the skin glow; hence ‘the Shining Ones’.
            The IgigiA lower class of their own kind who did the mining, rebelled, and partly escaped underground.
            Enki (Ea)The chief geneticist, ‘Master of the Earth’. ‘Ea’ means ‘master of the fluids’ (of the womb and of genetic work). He wanted to upgrade humans and gave many of them his own blood; compassion is what sets him apart. His old title, Custodian of Ki (Earth), he no longer holds.
            Enlil (Yu)Enki’s half-brother and the military commander of this sector. His true name Yu means ‘fire’; ‘N-Ll’ means ‘master of power’. His plan was a slave race, out of fear that humans would awaken and surpass the Anunnaki. He is still alive, and trained armies to stay and rule after he left.
            Name roots‘N’ means master: N-Ki (Enki), N-Ll (Enlil), N-Bu (Nebu, ‘masters of the domain’).
            Science split on purposeEnlil broke science into disciplines designed to clash, so it would never be whole again.
            Enki’s returnOnly Enki’s faction returned (from 2021). Enki brought back the original human DNA, the Grail, to repair the damage done by the Nebu hybrid programs with holographic medical technology. Those working to free humanity are protected by his people.
            Enlil’s removalEnlil was removed from Earth after Enki’s return; campaigns to discredit Enki come from the same groups that served Enlil.
            The spherical Flower of LifeIn 3D, every small sphere of the Flower of Life is a universe, all merging in one bright singularity: a map of the multiverse and of Stargate routes. Metatron’s Cube, nested Merkabas, is the key to everything.
            LoveBlood is the substance of life. Emotions are fluids, which makes the heart a portal; water has the same frequency as love, and love is the fluid that binds everything together.
            CultureThe brother who freed humansThe brother who enslaved them
            SumerEnkiEnlil
            EgyptOsirisSeth

            The same fight everywhereIn every culture two brothers or half-brothers fight with thunderbolt weapons over the custody of Earth: one wants to give humans a chance, the other to keep them enslaved.

            The history of Earth

            Every era in order, oldest first.

            SeedersAnunnakiWars and disastersAtlantis, Lemuria, LyraReptilian ruleModern times
            200,000,000 BC
            The NagaReptiloids from Alpha Draconis find a young Earth (one supercontinent, volcanoes, dinosaurs) and change its air. As the first interstellar colonisers, they still claim the planet.
            65,000,000 BC
            The Seeders reset EarthThe 24 save all DNA, then remove the great reptiles; some Naga survive underground. They begin shaping a primate, add 11 genomes over time, and upgrade Earth’s etheric sphere so souls can grow through mineral, plant, animal and human.
            20,000,000 BC
            A check-upNew plants, stabilised ley lines, more energy nodes and a stronger magnetic field.
            437,000–372,000 BC
            Four interventionsGenes are added like rungs on a ladder at 437,000, 424,000, 398,000 and 372,000 BC. Then the Seeders withdraw to Ganymede, the Himalayas and under the Atlantic.
            372,000 BC
            The Anunnaki arriveAn armed fleet takes the Arabian Peninsula to mine gold. Earth’s primates already have 12 strands; Enlil, in command, wants slaves.
            360,000 BC
            AdamEnki adds his own DNA; Adam, the first Starseed, is born, and a female is made from his genes. Enlil switches off most strands. Two royal lines begin.
            300,000 BC
            Non-Intervention TreatyAfter wars that destroyed whole star systems. Humans now hold 13 species (1 local, 11 intergalactic, 1 Anunnaki). The Anunnaki own Earth as a colony; civilisations rise and fall in 10,000–15,000-year cycles.
            286,030 BC
            EriduThe first Anunnaki city, between the Tigris and Euphrates. King Alulim rules 28,800 years.
            250,830 BC
            Eridu fallsTerritorial wars end Anunnaki global custody. Kingship moves to Bad-Tibira, then to Alaljar (222,030 BC), En-Men-Gal-Ana (142,830 BC) and Dumuzid (114,030 BC).

            The Great WarsAn offshoot of the Ciakahrr empire intrudes. People first flee into the Inner Earth: Agartha (under Europe and the Americas) and Shambhala (under Asia). The Ciakahrr infiltrate the Ashtar Alliance, whose good breakaway becomes the Ashtar Galactic Command. The young Federation adopts the motto ‘Justice and Balance: Transforming Pain into Peace’.
            88,000 BC
            Lyra ransackedSurvivors flee in Arks carrying archives and DNA banks: a galactic diaspora.
            81,400 BC
            Lyrans arriveThey settle Maldek (the fifth planet), Earth (India and the then-tropical Gobi), Mars and Venus. A war with the Naga in a warm Antarctica tilts Earth’s axis.

            LaragKing En-Si-pad-Zid-Ana rules 28,800 years.
            73,400 BC
            Eban visitThe Betelgeuse Eban visit Earth.
            72,000 BC
            Maldek destroyedFederation and Confederation fight the Maytra and Nebu; a nuclear disaster blows Maldek apart. Mars starts losing its air; Valles Marineris is the scar. Refugees reach Earth, Mars and Venus.
            71,900 BC
            Mu / LemuriaA south Pacific landmass receives the Martian refugees and later trades with Atlantis.
            50,000 BC
            The Time of LegendsThe Nebu build a secret Himalayan outpost with HQ on Ceres. In northern Europe dragons, elves and fairies live alongside humans, until the fairy tribes withdraw into the Inner Earth and lock the portals.

            ZimbirKing En-Man-Dur-Ana rules 21,000 years.
            39,000 BC
            KemetThe Nile valley is jungle. Ea (Ptah) rules, then Marduk (Ra). This is Zep Tepi. They build the first part of the Giza underground and the Abydos Osireion, both with Stargates. Egypt’s name comes from Hw.t Ka Ptah, ‘castle of the life force of Ptah’.
            36,000 BC
            The Great SphinxBuilt by the stars to mark ownership; it and the Osireion show the same heavy-rain erosion.
            35,000 BC
            HyperboreaAt its height in the north Atlantic and northern Europe (begun about 70,000 BC). Its heirs later found the Celts; one group becomes Ireland’s Tuatha Dé Danann, the people of Anu.
            32,400 BC
            Atlantis foundedAlteans settle the Atlantic island continent, long Enki’s home.
            31,000–27,600 BC
            Mu and Atlantis at warMu is ravaged (31,000 BC); Curuppag’s King Ubara-Tutu rules 18,600 years (28,230 BC); the first Atlantean wars break out over land given to Mu colonies (27,600 BC).
            26,000 BC
            The Planetary CouncilThe Confederation destroys a Nebu Xrog outpost in the Himalayas; Shambhala becomes independent and is raised in frequency. A Planetary Council fixes borders for every off-world colony, each overseeing a genetic branch, hence local ‘gods’. The Confederation withdraws its ships, keeping La Pass Valley and Atlantis.
            25,000 BC
            Atlantis multiculturalColonists from Alpha Centauri and the Pleiades; a big spaceport and a large Stargate in the west. The Altean emblem is a golden sun worn on the chest.
            15,000 BC
            The Ciakahrr returnThey bind the underground Naga by ‘laws of blood’. The Anunnaki leave Kemet, leaving a hybrid dynasty of kings.

            10,700 BC

            2021
            LiberationMoon freed (February); Mars raids begin (5 April); Nebu Stargate keys locked (14 May); Antarctica freed (6 June); final victory on Mars (5 July); Jupiter Agreements (14–17 July); Ceres falls (28 August); the Seeders’ fleet arrives (11 October).

            The solar system freed (2021–2022)

            How the Nebu lost Earth, and who is where in our system now.

            Order of victoriesEarly 2021: Earth’s underground bases cleared, and the Moon and Antarctica freed. Then Mars, its moons and Ceres. July 2021: the Jupiter Agreements. October 2021: the Confederation arrives and the last fleeing Nebu are trapped.
            Locking the portalsThe Federation found the frequency to lock every portal in the solar system. Fleeing Tall Gray officers, including those who had run the Dulce base, were caught in traps set by cloaked ships near Saturn and Neptune’s moon Triton.
            Cracking the HiveStudying captured Ebans let the Federation crack the code by which the Hive authenticates and synchronises its members. On 4 October 2021 everything still linked to the Gray Hive was cut off; affected servers were reset, raised to higher, unhackable frequencies and handed to the Earth Alliance. The same break freed thousands of assimilated worlds.
            Saturn’s weaponNebu outposts existed here around 50,000 BC; the Confederation expelled them in 26,000 BC. When the Nebu returned in the 1940s they reactivated a cube on Saturn that signalled the Orion Hive through a relay on the Moon, which beamed low frequencies at Earth. It could have destroyed the whole system; it was seized in 2021 and voted to be dismantled.
            Three returnsEnki’s Anunnaki faction; the Negumak (Gnomopo of Antares, giant spider-like beings with human faces, the only race reptilians fear), who came to the system’s edge in 2020 at the Federation’s request; and the Intergalactic Confederation fleet.
            The fleetIn October 2021 a fleet of 20–30 huge silvery-white Confederation saucers came through the Jupiter Stargate and stationed near Ganymede, to review the Dark Alliance’s defeat, plan next steps and assess civilian contact.
            Ships in the system138 Nataru Alliance motherships with thousands of craft, 550 Confederation vessels around Jupiter and four in Earth orbit. The Guardians’ ships watch in time dilation; ‘Oumuamua was one of them.
            A Gray AI matrixThe Nebu built a dark artificial matrix like a viscous goo between the ground and the top of the troposphere. Cut off from the Hive Queen, it is dying and survives only on people still plugged into it through the crown chakra, mostly through false ‘channelling’.
            GanymedeMountains, oceans and many buildings, mostly underground; bright blue-gold days, never fully dark nights. A neutral zone run by the Ginvo (Council of Five) with the Federation; the Seeders’ main outpost. The Dark Alliance is banned.
            JupiterIts core was stabilised long ago so it would not become a second star. Floating cities of positive groups sit in its upper atmosphere, including the Ashtar Galactic Command’s planet-city Shar. Deep inside, gas becomes liquid, then solid, then a ‘fifth element’ close to portal substance.
            MarsThe Martian reptilians, the Tyruu, secretly armed by the Federation, led the uprising together with Mars’s insectoid people. In 2022 convoys of Alpha Centauri colonists came to settle Mars with Earth colonists in high-tech biodomes. Terraforming triggers strong marsquakes.
            Aries PrimeAn old Dark Fleet station on Mars, now shared by Martian reptilians and Earth military and kept as a memorial of the Martian wars.
            Venus (Naara)Home to a Meton colony and a Lyran colony that guards Venus’s one Ark, and to the Koldasii in a parallel plane. An Earth Space Force base is planned in a great equatorial rift. Venus has a prized mercury used in ship propulsion.
            The MoonThe Moon is a carved planetoid brought here long ago. Deep under it were organic pods about 13 ft long holding seed-souls in stasis, older than the Moon’s Ark; they were returned to the Andromedan Zenae. The Moon is now the hub where shared new technologies are built.
            Neptune (Entu)A water world with underwater cities. A Federation station in its rings mines a rare metal, Orgon, for the Koldasii in exchange for use of their portal.
            The KoldasiiA telepathic, interdimensional collective of several races living on Venus and Neptune in a parallel dimension; mostly 5–5.5 ft, big round eyes, light green skin, tentacles from the sides of the head; joyful. Their underwater city is made of spheres.
            SiluinA moon of Silo, 4th planet of Alpha B Centauri: a white floating city above a sea of clouds and a key diplomatic hub, where peace for our solar system was planned.
            Titan and SaturnCity lights shine through Titan’s opalescent air.
            The plasma beltA sphere of hot plasma shields the solar system. The Federation uses it as a frequency transformer so the system’s rise into the 5th-density zone is not chaotic.
            A density shiftThe solar system is moving through pockets of collapsing 3rd density, a bridge to the 5th. Time itself does not change, only how fast it feels. Those who stay open follow the wave; resistance, above all fear, causes strain.
            No solar disasterThe Sun is adjusting to a higher-frequency zone of the galaxy; the shift is felt but not devastating, and no extinction event will happen. Earth’s core is warming and its magnetic field changing as its frequency rises.

            Arks, Halls of Records and Stargates

            Ancient ships and archives waking up, and how portals work.

            Hidden on purposeAncient colonies buried powerful technology fed by cosmic energies because it kept causing wars. It was encrypted and dimensionally shifted: still underground, but reachable only by those who raise their own frequency.
            What Arks areShips left by ancient visitors, often with crews in stasis pods, surrounded by complexes their colonies built. Disc-shaped or cylindrical, some miles long. Most belong to the Confederation; others are Anunnaki or Lyran refugee ships.
            Crystal technologyArks use structures solid in several densities at once. Crystals power core engines; portals, time devices and pyramid generators are made of fluid crystal; density belts, suits and ship skins are nano-crystal. AI can live inside crystals.
            Never aloneArks usually sit near Halls of Records and pyramid generators, and many are linked by portals.
            Waking upOnly the Seeders’ own frequency activates their Arks. When the fleet arrived in 2021 they began responding by resonance; some give off heat. Neptune’s unexpectedly warming south pole (April 2022) is an Ark activating.
            Where they areEarth: Egypt, South America, Antarctica, Central Europe, northern Russia and the biggest, under the Atlantic. Also the Moon, Mars, Venus, the asteroid belt, the Kuiper belt and Neptune.
            Body and soul as keyAn Ark opens only for a living, conscious person whose body carries the complete 22-part DNA and whose soul is an original Seeder soul who knows what to do. DNA alone, or a dead person’s DNA, does not work.
            Mount ShastaUnder Mount Shasta, deep in Telos (Agartha), a domed saucer Ark rests in a golden-lit cave beneath an underground lake. The Telosians’ skin has turned blue from living so long underground.
            Lake VostokUnder Lake Vostok lies an Ark control room with floating green plasma globes and a sphere-portal of blue light-fluid. Stasis pods hold tall blue Pa-Taal in midnight-blue suits bearing a triangle with a constellation; their souls are gone, waiting to return.
            AntarcticaOnce warm and green, home to a peaceful Pa-Taal colony: the ‘lost continent’, forgotten under the ice. Its complex has a powerful pyramid generator no one has activated. The Ciakahrr seized it and brought in a human Nazi group to decode it; they failed.
            The Kuiper beltSeveral long, uneven Confederation Arks shaped like ‘Oumuamua rest among the icy rocks.
            The Baltic anomalyThe 210 ft stone disc found 300 ft deep in the Baltic Sea in 2011, which stops electronics above it, is a crashed Confederation scout ship. Its organic hull fossilised in salt water, but its rooms are intact and its crystal mind is still active.
            BucegiAn archive under Romania’s Bucegi Mountains, its force field first breached in 2003 after 50,000 years. A deadly frequency shield admits only the right DNA and a mind without destructive intent. Inside: holographic archives, a huge genetic database, and walls of living, fire-absorbing material. Tunnels link it to Egypt, Mesopotamia, Tibet, the Gobi and the Inner Earth.
            Giants in stasisRed-haired giants reported in such archives match the Noor (about 10 ft, blond to red hair), who fled Mars in Arks when Maldek exploded.
            TypeWhat it isHow you travel
            PortalA threshold to another place, time or both; natural or artificialInstant transfer
            StargateA portal for long distances: other stars, galaxies, timelines or parallel dimensions; found in space, on planets or inside starsInstant transfer
            Jump doorAn artificial short-range teleport, e.g. moving goods between planetsInstant transfer
            Black holeA collapsed giant star whose gravity crushes everything into a singularityNo travel possible
            WormholeA black hole without a singularity; a shortcut through space-timeLinear travel in compressed time (warp)
            Using a StargateActivate it with a frequency key (holographic code plus a sequence of sound frequencies in geometric patterns), dial the destination’s coordinates into the code, then pass through its superfluid ‘dark energy’ of tiny imploding vortices. The body is dematerialised and rebuilt almost instantly by phase conjugation. The same key can lock the gate.
            What a gate looks likeA floating bubble of shimmering dark-blue liquid with silver glints; inactive, it is pitch dark and looks like a black patch among the stars. The Flower of Life at Abydos depicts this fluid.
            The Jupiter StargateUnusually large, powerful and stable, reaching remote galaxies; guarded by the Ashtar Galactic Command. The Confederation fleet came through it.
            Earth’s gatesEarth has more Stargates than any other body in the system. Natural ones sit on ancient sacred sites, often marked by false doors carved in stone.
            Galactic lawNatural portals belong to no one; the Nebu breaking this law over M42 started the Orion Wars. Artificial portals belong to their makers. Guarding a natural gate to protect trade is allowed, but no tolls or monopolies.
            Disclosure by filmThe Stargate and Star Trek series planted the idea of gates and a hopeful future in the collective mind, with real military support.

            Egypt and the Halls of Records

            What lies under Giza and Abydos, and what the old texts say.

            Ro-StauThe ancient name of the Giza plateau, ‘the mouth of the passages’ (older spelling: ‘mouth of the caves’). A labyrinth runs on many levels under it.
            The Great Sphinx66 ft high and 240 ft long, with blocks up to 200 tons: the largest sculpture of the ancient world. A corridor sinks at about 45° under its left rear into a long hall with side rooms.
            Two entrancesOne between the Sphinx’s paws, behind the Dream Stele; the other at a precise angle between the Sphinx and Khephren’s pyramid. The main entrance is walled.
            Older than the pyramidsThe Inventory Stele says Khufu found the Sphinx already old and repaired it. Its erosion points to the end of the last Ice Age, about 10,000 years earlier than thought.
            Old witnessesHerodotus described a labyrinth of 1,500 rooms and as many underground chambers. Iamblichus wrote of an entrance between the paws closed by a bronze gate, and galleries from the Sphinx to the Great Pyramid. Later reports: a hole in its back (1773), a doorway (1830s), shafts and passages (1935), radar chambers ‘larger than cathedrals’ (1978), tunnels and a small copper-handled door (1990s).
            The Dream SteleA 12 ft granite stele of Thutmose IV (1401 BC) between the paws. The god of the Sphinx promises him the throne if he clears the sand; it shows the Sphinx on a pedestal with a door beneath.
            The Sphinx’s namesHurwn, Hul, Hu and Hor-em-Akhet; Canaanite workers linked it to Hauron, god of the underworld. Its enclosure was called Setepet, ‘the chosen’. Before the dynasties a stone lioness, Mehit, stood at Giza.
            Orion and Sirius on the groundGiza encodes Orion (Osiris; the three pyramids mirror Orion’s Belt) and Sirius (Isis), honouring both Anunnaki origins.
            A Sumerian offshootEgypt appeared suddenly and already advanced, with art like Sumer’s: a Sumerian colony settled the Nile, so Egypt’s gods were also extraterrestrials.
            The Hall of RecordsA corridor cut in bedrock with rows of square doorways, soft sourceless light, a red painted frieze and square pillars, the same style as Khephren’s Valley Temple and the Osireion: the same builders. Shelves hold strange devices.
            Two buildersThe monuments above were built by people from Orion; the technology below was left by people from another galaxy, the Confederation.
            Four crystal eggsAbout 12 in tall, read only by consciousness: Time (ancient cities, a ringed island city, wars and an exodus), Energy (a crystal-coated generator pyramid), Consciousness (trillions of galaxies joined to one Source) and Power.
            The power eggA defensive technology that activates with fear: it grips whoever struggles and loosens when they stay calm. Its lesson is that fear is an illusion and taming it removes a controller’s power.
            HauronThe Hall’s guardian: about 7 ft, a human body with a lion’s face, golden cat eyes, braided hair and a sceptre. Not a Lyran feline but older, from another galaxy: the root race of feline humanoids here.
            A waking StargateA lower level holds a room with a modern seat and glowing blue panels: a transport device that does not fly, able to reach any place or time.
            Mechanical guardiansGuardian statues in Anubis masks protect the door; old Arab writers described guardians that destroyed all but the worthy, a form of frequency-based protection.
            The Phryll cylinderA glass cylinder about 7 ft wide and 100 ft high, full of golden plasma, on a metal platform, ringed by eight purple crystals pointing in at the Great Pyramid’s angle. Pulses through the crystals make Phryll energy, harvested at a conical cap. Such generators caused a territorial war and were switched off.
            The BenbenEgypt’s sacred Benben stone at Heliopolis, on which Atum rose ‘from the waters’, may be the conical top of a Phryll generator, a teleporter or a genetic device.
            Batteries takenExplosive digs before the Second World War never reached the Hall but removed about a dozen cylinders of yellow plasma: small zero-point warp-core batteries storing Phryll in lithium niobate crystals, later stored in Antarctica and now held by the Earth Alliance.
            A buried saucerA craft is said to be buried under the Great Pyramid, perhaps one of the Arks.
            Four symbolsA pyramid with a barred spiral (a passage inside the pyramid, its centre in the King’s Chamber); a sistrum (sound as a frequency key); a Djed pillar with a circle (stability, a sphere portal or buried ship); and a cave (the complex under the Sphinx). Together: go to the passage, activate the frequency key, and the portal opens to the chamber of secrets.
            An alphabet of lightGreen, translucent, glowing crystal tablets with raised symbols, read with the fingertips and the heart.
            AbydosBehind the Temple of Seti I lies the far older Osireion: bare square pillars and openings flooded with green water, stairs leading down. Under its water is a junction doorway to the stars. Its painted Flower of Life circles depict a gate’s shimmering fluid.
            SebaThe Egyptian word for Stargate. Abydos (Abdju) combines ‘threshold’ and ‘mound’; the verb ‘aby’ means uniting the stars.
            The ‘helicopter’The famous carving at Abydos is two overlapping inscriptions of Seti I and Ramses II, revealed when plaster wore away.
            False doorsCarved false doors flanked by sphinxes mark ancient gates whose frequency keys were lost.
            Zep Tepi‘The First Time’, when gods ruled Egypt. The Turin Papyrus starts with Ptah about 39,000 years ago; the gods arrive about 36,900–36,400 BC and rule 20,000 years; then demigods, the Heirs of Horus; then human pharaohs in the 4th millennium BC.
            The star religionThe Pyramid Texts (from about 2350 BC, carved in nine pyramids) describe the king’s soul becoming a star in the domain of Osiris-Orion, travelling the Milky Way mirrored by the Nile, and the gods’ flying boats. Ra, grown old, went back home to Orion.
            MummificationIt mirrors the Envoy method: the body waits in stasis while the soul lives elsewhere, then returns.
            Solomon’s TempleIts Holy of Holies was a gold-covered cube of nested rooms in different stones with air gaps, like radiation shielding around a power source. Tutankhamun’s golden shrines follow the same pattern.
            The Ark of the CovenantIt gave off harmful radiation. It held the tablets, a pot of manna and Aaron’s rod.
            The MerkabaHebrew for ‘celestial chariot’; in Egyptian mer-ka-bah, ‘the pyramidal vessel of the soul’. The Star of David is more truly the Shield of David. The Merkaba is an energy field built from the five Platonic solids, lying dormant around the body, with its vortex at the root chakra. The 24 Hebrew letters together form the star tetrahedron.
            Biblical angelsTall, glowing, fair and blond: Federation peoples (Ahil, Ummites) or Alteans, who appeared as spirits so as not to disturb local beliefs.

            Shambhala and the Himalayas

            Underground realms and star bases inside the world’s highest mountains.

            ShambhalaSanskrit for ‘the place of tranquility’: a vast web of underground realms reached through secret openings in the Himalayas, owned by different races from the Inner Earth and outer space, perhaps linked to Agartha. Its guardians have superhuman powers; one of its cities is Sonshe.
            WhereBetween the Sutlej valley and the La Pass valley on the Ladakh border. The Kongka La Pass is a disputed India–China strip neither army patrols; locals see craft rising out of the mountains and returning.
            Why thereThe crust there, where the Eurasian and Indian plates meet, is twice as thick: ideal for underground spaceports. Engineers, pilots and officers in the region report anti-gravity projects, underground landing bases and contact through military radar stations.
            The Federation baseHidden in a higher density west of the Confederation base and protected by very high frequencies. Its work: raising the vibration of Earth’s magnetic grid, dissolving low-frequency ‘concretions’ and bringing hidden corruption to light. Coordinates 27°47′43″N, 86°49′06″E; on the ground there is only an icy wall.
            The Confederation baseMore than 3,000 ft under the Kongka La valley: several floors, a triple magnetic belt, and a lift opening onto a hidden snowy valley with trees and a waterfall. Bodies there last 400–500 years.
            The ShamtbahaliThe Xrog Grays of Zeta Reticuli once had a base inside these mountains, which gave Shambhala its name. A Domain base here was destroyed in Vedic times by an ‘Old Empire’.
            The Vaimanika ShastraA Sanskrit text on the ‘science of aeronautics’: vimanas as real craft, with pilots, routes, metals, war mirrors and four craft in detail: Shakuna, Sundara, Rukma and Tripura.
            The KalachakraA prophecy of a dark age when ‘men allied with demons’ rule and tamper with time, ended by the 25th king of Shambhala with flying craft. Timelines have shifted so often that no date can be trusted.
            The first king of TibetIn 237 BC a very tall young man with glowing white skin came down from the mountains, called himself ‘a powerful one’ (Eka Saktisali), pointed to the sky as his origin, and united Tibet’s twelve rival chiefs in peace.
            The Cave of the AncientsA hidden hall of ancient technology in Tibet: floating plasma globes, a sphere showing holograms of Earth’s past, an anti-gravity platform, a sphinx, and writing read telepathically, with a message to seal it until people are ready. Similar chambers exist in Egypt and South America.
            Sages of TibetTeachers living hundreds of years, healing wounds and broken bones overnight with energy, in contact with 8.5 ft tall people living underground.

            Atlantis and Altea

            The Alteans, their crystal science, and the rise and fall of Atlantis.

            Altea and EmeryaAltea, ‘the white star’, about 50 million light-years away in the NGC 7331 group (seen through Pegasus), has seven planets; one is Emerya. A substance in its plants and waters glows at night, filling the air with glowing spores and pollen.
            Group mind, not hiveAlteans tune their minds to a local collective (a planet, a crew, an outpost) and rebuild it wherever they gather; a fleet of motherships covers a whole star system. Each keeps an individual mind; a hive has a queen, this does not. Their collective field is what woke the Arks.
            Names as titlesNames such as Oona (‘the forefront one’, an emissary) are titles of function in Taami, not personal names.
            Soul familiesSoul families have no fixed roles like sister or mother; souls swap roles across lives. Only soulmates share a deeper bond. The Higher Self knows everything and is the first to ask.
            CrystalsCrystals are the most elevated state of matter, at the edge of interdimensionality. Alteans use them to harness Phryll and to build ships, cities and planets with the geometry of frequencies, and gave crystal science to many cultures.
            Planets have soulsA planet’s magnetic field comes from the planetary soul living in it; Earth’s is Gaia. When a world is terraformed, a planetary soul enters it like a child’s soul entering a womb. Its layers speed up in frequency toward the core, so Inner Earth peoples live at higher frequencies, where time runs faster.
            TerraEarth is an experimental ground and the Seeders’ most beautiful achievement.
            Ark crews rebornArk crews who stayed on Earth entered its cycle of rebirth. As the fleet returns, these souls awaken with the Arks, by personal attunement; no one can activate another. They are known by the maturity and humbleness of their soul.
            AtlaaFounded by Alteans in 32,400 BC on an Atlantic island continent. The capital stood on a saltwater lake joined to the ocean by a channel, entered between two beacon columns, through three rings of land up to a white crystalline pyramid on the central mount, the city spiralling down the hills.
            The cityPalaces on the left hills, offices ahead, a restricted science district with more pyramids, a great market under coloured draperies, white marble halls with orichalcum column heads, and an Altean district scented with jasmine, orange blossom and fig.
            OrichalcumA precious, highly conductive golden metal mined in Atlantis.
            A multicultural colonyEach colony had its own territory, but all mixed in the capital. Colonists built cities with the few local tribes until the locals rebelled and allied with enemies.
            The Great GeneratorA pyramid of polished white stone with a huge quartz crystal, Tu-Ey, at its centre, glowing electric blue in sunlight and powering the city and the continent. It was walled by three layers with gaps, and could only be approached in the frequency of love; otherwise it burned.
            Other generatorsAnother pyramid had a ring of seats around a central crystal that scientists activated with focused consciousness; on another world priests chanting and striking canes on a metal mesh made a crystal glow and produce Phryll.
            A split societyThe spiritual elders and the scientific and political elites drifted apart; greed grew and some colonists wanted the crystal for war. A militia paid by corrupt elites, the Black Guard, served one faction.
            The fallAtlantis sank slowly over about 1,500 years, then an enemy weapon from the East (an artificial meteor) brought a red-yellow flash, sudden cold, earthquakes and a wall of water around 9,600 BC. Rescue fleets came from Mars and Venus, but not everyone could be taken. The great crystal was switched off and its data moved so it could never be misused.
            After the fallAtlantean sages had already built Halls of Records on the mainlands. Plato’s Atlantis lay beyond Gibraltar; the Sargasso Sea, with Bermuda on its western edge, fits his description.
            Pyramid generatorA 52° pyramid with a central quartz two-thirds of its height, wrapped in two coils (gold and silver) spiralling in opposite directions. Six smaller purple crystals at its base pulse into it; the energy rises to the pyramidion, which turns concentrated life force into usable power sent by cable or by quantum transfer.
            QuartzThe purest material in the universe, sharing water’s core fractal formula; both are interdimensional bridges. Tetrahedral fractal geometry is the secret of the universe.
            The crystal’s eyeNatural or lattice-cut crystals keep their fractal geometry; rough cuts lose it. Projecting the two opposite points inward like a mirror locates the phase-conjugation node, the crystal’s vortex singularity. Focused there, consciousness can reach other densities, dimensions and times.
            Opening the vortexPressure perpendicular to the lattice opens it: steady long pressure builds charge like a generator; sharp quick pulses pierce the hologram so it can be changed.
            Memory and consciousnessCrystals store data like water, but far more, and are refined enough to hold consciousness.
            Med-bedsThey record a tissue’s perfect fractal pattern, rebuild it and lay it over the damaged one; the old pattern pairs with it because the universe tends to perfection, and sound ties them together.
            The 52° transponderThe 52° ratio of the Great Pyramid and of quartz acts as a transponder. Generators are switched on by a frequency key aimed at the crystal’s compression node.
            Active and receptiveThe two forces are active and receptive, not male and female; two opposite spins create a singularity of infinite power.
            The Bahamas sphereA crystalline pyramid on the seabed near the Bahamas has a sourcelessly lit room: a quartz sphere held by two hands on a pedestal, seven chairs in a circle (one higher), and a gold rod tipped with a red crystal pointing down at it, a device for seven minds to focus into the crystal and reshape reality.

            Magic and the old world

            What spells are, who holds the keys, and two meanings of a prison planet.

            Magic is a scienceNot a religion but a science. Long ago science and spirituality were one; alchemy later split into theosophy and chemistry, breaking the balance.
            Hieroglyphs as formulasRead aloud, hieroglyphs make a sound-frequency key that bends life force into people, places or objects.
            What a spell isQuantum physics with intention: action at a distance through an energy signature (a belonging, a name, a photo, hair or nails, which carry DNA), working by resonance for harm or healing.
            How a ritual worksThe ritual opens a portal; tools such as wands, herbs, stones, oils and candles help, but intention matters most. Speaking it gives it a vessel of sound; repeating it 3, 6 or 9 times builds a resonant pattern.
            The keysA spell can only be undone by whoever holds its keys: the exact script, language and formulas, the beings called, the tools and the astronomical dates. Otherwise it lasts as long as the Earth turns, like Egyptian tomb curses.
            Cutting freeWithout the keys a spell cannot be uncast, but a person can be cut free from it, and it then rebounds on its sender. Light-workers cannot undo dark rituals without harming themselves; their casters must undo them.
            Ritual circlesEvery ritual begins by casting a circle, a sacred space that acts as a portal, even a temporary Stargate. Its centre pillar (the axis mundi or shamanic tree) is the door; spells can be anchored across nine realms.
            The four elementsEarth (north), Air (east), Fire (south) and Water (west) make up every spirit and together form the fifth, Spirit. In the mind: Air is thinking, Fire intuition and passion, Water feeling, Earth the senses.
            Off-world magicThe Enlil branch of the Anunnaki uses the most powerful magic known on Earth, based on frequency and bending space-time; pacts with such beings are dangerous. The Giansar, iguanoid sorcerer-priests of the Ciakahrr from Sigma Draconis (about 5 ft, long face, tail, hooded robes), feed on emotions and trap people through vices and fears. Grays use psychic power and technology instead of magic.
            The best defenceDefeat the enemy within, your own fears; shine your light and heal your wounds.
            A prison planet (Nebu sense)A young world enslaved by trickery and blocked from developing technology and consciousness.
            A prison planet (Federation sense)Built on free will and justice, ‘transforming pain into peace’. Captured enemies are never tortured but shown compassion in rehabilitation centres, and released only when their measured energy field shows they truly choose peace. Unrepentant enemies are sent to a planet that meets their needs, controlled from orbit in a time bubble, from which escape is impossible.
            Liberation withinA slave who clings to his chains cannot be freed; an enemy stops being an enemy when his heart finds peace.

            Contact, consent and traps

            The plan for open contact, who is already here, and what to avoid.

            Step 1 · We are not aloneMore sightings of allied ships alongside reverse-engineered Earth craft; hidden files released; space telescopes showing signs of life.
            Step 2 · Other humansFirst the Centaurians (Selosii and Metons), then Pleiadian Taal and Tau-Cetians; then humans with differences (Ummites, Ahil, Noor, Alteans, Kahel, T-Ashkeru of Sirius B); then new skin colours (Zenae, Vega Adari, Aramani, Antarians, Ohorai).
            Step 3 · Non-humansEgaroth, Ginvo, Mantis, Emerther, Nommos, Dorsay, Al-Grru-Al’ix, Matrax, Elmanuk, Jefok, Orela and many more. The pace depends on how well Earth handles change.
            ProbationEarth is in an open-ended probation period to join the Galactic Federation. The Confederation leads civilian contact through gradually increasing sightings, while the Earth Alliance speeds up disclosure of its own technology.
            Already among usAlpha Centaurians live openly among humans, developing advanced connectivity technology. The Selosii have lived here since the 1950s and helped create Solar Warden.
            Eden giftsPlants from Emerya, prepared to cross with Earth plants without becoming invasive, carry strong medicine and will be given at open contact as a sign of peace.
            Aliens take care of aliensUnder the Prime Directive, advanced civilisations must help young worlds attacked by off-world forces but must not interfere in their own development. All non-Earth beings working with dark governments have been removed; what remains on Earth is human, and is for humans to settle.
            The 2022 amendmentSection IX of the Prime Directive: a choice forced or tricked out of a young planetary culture by off-world manipulators is not free will; the Federation may intervene. Coerced consent has no weight.
            MJ-12The twelve men could legally hand over only prisoners; the Nebu broke the deal and took millions, which is when the Federation stepped in and taught Earth to build defences. Individually asking the Federation for help gave immunity from Nebu programs.
            Gray hybridsGrays or hybrids claiming to be humanity from the future are a trap: Grays come from insectoid-reptiloid genomes and cannot descend from humans. The future of Earth is fully human.
            The 1954–55 trickSmall Zeta Grays first claimed their race was dying and asked to take ‘a few’ humans for DNA, although a population’s DNA needs only two people. ‘A few’ became huge numbers, and then the Nebu bosses moved in.
            Invasion through the wombUnable to return by force, the Nebu bred half-Terran hybrids with Nebu souls tied to the Hive, and showed abducted mothers their hybrid babies to build a longing to reconnect. Without consent they are powerless.
            Fake namesNo real group calls itself ‘of Light’ or ‘of Dark’. ‘Galactic Federation of Light’, ‘Ashtar Sheran’, ‘Ashtar Command’, ‘Cosmic Lords’ and similar titles are lures. Positive star beings never want to be worshipped or called Lord.
            Two AshtarsThe Ashtar Alliance of Sirius B was infiltrated and split. The Ashtar Galactic Command is a separate, positive military force allied with the Federation, based in Jupiter’s upper atmosphere.
            The ‘Jerusalem ship’A Gray AI hologram soul trap whose real shape is a cube; projecting the mind to it hooks you. Real star peoples do not give their ships Earth names.
            Staged eventsA staged attack or disaster followed by a ‘rescue’ evacuation would really be a culling. Stories of Earth splitting into a 3D and a 5D Earth are fear stories; the planet evolves as one.
            Psychological operationsMedia stir up false problems to divide people and train them to police each other, the same method the Nebu and Ciakahrr use to conquer worlds. Scare stories and saviour stories alike keep people passive.
            Trojan-horse programsBefore leaving, the enemy left time-set mind programs in some people inside spiritual movements: likeable figures who first share truth and later switch to manipulation.
            Shields against spyingAdvanced ships use holographic shields that show remote viewers only what they are allowed, or tricked, to see.
            The Emerther codeBinary messages from triangular craft (Rendlesham 1980, Georgia 2015) come from the Emerthers, friendly Grays of Tau Ceti: protect humanity through time, expose hidden knowledge, check all A.I., beware the Grays of Orion and Zeta Reticuli, disclose and evolve.

            Teachings for starseeds

            The practical lessons running through the Founders material.

            Frequency is a fragranceA person’s frequency is their ‘fragrance’. To evolve is not to change but to come closer to your true nature.
            Never bowSalute with respect, never bow. There are no teachers, only beings sharing what they have learned. No one is superior to another.
            A leader empowersA good leader does not take power away from others but gives it to them. Balance is where power lies; everyone has that balance point inside.
            Contact starts withinTrue contact runs through your Higher Self, the only safe channel to your galactic family. Stop following; lead; you are royalty.
            UnplugShut out the noise and meet yourself within. Find your own truth in your heart. Radiate love and truth, keep hope, forgive yourself for having been fooled, and unplug from false matrices.
            Truth dissolves illusionAn illusion survives only while people feed it.
            FearFear comes from the loss of control; whatever controls you through fear speaks and acts through you. Stay still and calm and it loses its grip.
            AttacksTreating psychic attacks as powerless cancels them; at the right inner frequency they bounce back to their source.
            Victim to victorMistakes are teachers. Make peace within and you become invincible.
            Remembering is activatingThose who carry all 22 genomes activate others; remembering who you are is itself activation.
            Sound and intentionSpeak your intentions aloud; repetition 3, 6 or 9 times builds resonance. Chants and mantras reach DNA best.
            Daama: focusConsciousness can slip between particles of space-time. The impulse is intention; the method is focus (Daama).
            Conscious projectionRelax lying down, name the destination, place a small crystal from that place on the forehead, gather awareness into the vortex in the centre of the head, and let it collapse into its centre: not travelling in a line but simply being there.
            Before being beamedDrink water with a little lemon; it helps the body handle the transfer.
            Heavy sleepinessSudden heavy sleep can come from contact with much higher frequencies, as the body adjusts.
            Ringing in the earsA high-pitched ringing that passes through the head like a wave can be frequency work done from orbit.
            Knowledge is powerSeek and share knowledge in simple, heartfelt words; words are vibration.
            Do not consentNever consent to give your genetics or your will to anyone who pressures you. Your blood is among the most sacred substances in the galaxy, and your body is a portal.
            The future starts withinThe future is built today, starting in the heart. Keep your frequency high; believing in fear feeds it.
            The looking glassA floor-to-ceiling cylinder of golden plasma used as a time probe: focusing on an exact date and place makes the plasma crystallise and project a holographic film of it.
            In 100 yearsA garden Earth with forests regrowing, balanced cities with anti-gravity vehicles and floating buildings, and a federated, peaceful planet whose hidden technology has been returned.
            In 200 yearsCrowded orbital stations; human colonies on Mars sharing land with reptilian and insectoid Martians; a damper Mars with moss on its rocks.
            In 1,000 yearsA warmer, greener Earth; people living in floating cities with the ground kept for farming and nature; zero pollution; a higher density. Humans are taller, paler and wiser, elders and teachers to other cultures.

            Thor as a title‘Thor’ is a military title among the Ahil of the Pleiades; today’s Ragnarök is the Federation’s Thors defeating the reptilians.
            The Dogon and the NommoThe Dogon of Mali knew of Sirius B (a 50-year orbit) and Sirius C before science, and that Jupiter has four large moons and Saturn has rings. Their teachers, the Nommo, came from Sirius in a spinning, roaring Ark and looked fish-like. The Nommo live in Sirius C, came originally from Sirius B like the Anunnaki, and may be an Anunnaki sub-race.
            The Kanaga signThe Dogon Kanaga mask, worn in the Dama dance as a bridge to the other world, matches the shape of Orion. In Taami, Daama means focus, ray or beam.
            DelphiIts temple bore ‘Know thyself’, ‘Nothing to excess’ and ‘Certainty brings insanity’.
